parts.name: Blade Handle Set (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This part consists of one blade and one handle loop of the scissors, made of stainless steel with a plastic-coated handle for comfort.
parts.Functional_description: It provides one cutting edge and one handle loop for gripping and applying force during cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central screw relative to the other blade handle set to perform the cutting motion.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This part includes the second blade and handle loop, also made of stainless steel with a plastic-coated handle.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the second cutting edge and handle loop, working in conjunction with the first blade handle set to cut materials.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the screw, moving opposite to the other blade handle set to create a shearing action.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: A small steel screw that connects the two blade handle sets at the pivot point.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the two blade handle sets together and allows them to pivot smoothly for cutting action.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed in place, serving as the rotational axis for the two blade handle sets.
